summary: Linn County, Oregon, Willamette NF lookout: camp in the 1920s, L-4 cab in 1932, removed in 1986. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 cab that replaced an early camp with an alidade

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register, ORWW and Forest Lookouts say removed in 1986; firelookout.com says destroyed in the same year. The year is agreed; only the manner of the end differs.
A July 1939 item gives 5,942 feet. The register and ORWW give 5,312 feet (1,619 m), which matches the record; the record is kept.

notes_for_editor: Dates disagree across sources: first set-up 1920 (ORWW) vs 1923 (register); cab is an L-4 cab in 1932 (register, firelookout.com) vs a gable-roofed R-1 type house c.1931 (Forest Lookouts). The 1939 item's 5,942 ft elevation is the outlier; the record's 1,619 m matches the register. Access stays unknown: no source describes access or the site today, so no access or visit fact is written. Do not confuse with the Washington lookout also called Twin Butte (washingtonlookouts.weebly.com); it is a different site and was not used. The record's kind 'ground' was not changed; no source describes the structure's base.
